<!-- Generated by scripts/docs-tokens.mjs from src/styles/tokens.cjs and tailwind.config.cjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Tokens follow the VVF website spec's design system (5.1 to 5.4). Colours have one source, `src/styles/tokens.cjs`: Tailwind's palette and the CSS variables (`--navy`, `--blue-text`, …) are built from it, and a unit test fails on any colour literal in a component, page, layout or stylesheet.

Font roles: Nunito for headings, buttons, body text and UI labels; Open Sans for taglines, labels and small text (spec 5.2).

## colors (src/styles/tokens.cjs)

| Token (CSS variable) | Value | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--navy` | `#02335e` | headings, body text, navbar, dark bands, outline-navy buttons |
| `--blue` | `#00abf9` | primary button fill, bullets, focus outline; text only on navy |
| `--blue-text` | `#0074a9` | Blue text on light backgrounds, the Outline button and the big impact figures (Enrique, Q13 on the spec card, 2026-10-14): `blue` is 2.56:1 on white, under WCAG AA. 5.16:1 on white, 4.61:1 on `page`; on the pastels only 3.9 to 4.3:1, enough for large text and lines. |
| `--sky` | `#c1e7f5` | pastel card and section background |
| `--sun` | `#f9eac6` | pastel card and section background |
| `--salmon` | `#ffd7d7` | pastel card and section background |
| `--grey-line` | `#e7e7e7` | borders and dividers |
| `--white` | `#ffffff` | cards, text on navy |
| `--page` | `#f2f2f2` | page background |
| `--link` | `#1e73be` | links in body text |
| `--success` | `#cef5ca` | status message background |
| `--success-dark` | `#114e0b` | status message text |
| `--warning` | `#fcf8d8` | status message background |
| `--warning-dark` | `#5e5515` | status message text |
| `--error` | `#f8e4e4` | status message background |
| `--error-dark` | `#3b0b0b` | status message text |

Keyboard focus (Q12): `--focus` (`blue`) outlines the element and `--focus-inner` (`navy`) fills the 2 px gap inside it, from the one `:focus-visible` rule in `src/index.css`. Components don't set their own focus colours.
